Agent hangs or times out: The local/IDE agent or chat is stuck, spins, says 'taking longer than expected' or 'planning next moves', stops mid-task with no error, or responds extremely slowly. Not cloud agents or Grok Bot; an explicit error message goes to 'Model request fails with an error'.
Model request fails with an error: A chat or agent request returns an error: provider error, 'unexpected error' with a Request ID, high load or high demand, rate limited, blocked by the model provider's usage policy, 'trouble connecting to the model', service unavailable, or a specific Cursor-provided model that just won't work.
Network or proxy connection errors: Failures caused by the network: proxies, VPNs, firewalls, HTTP/2, corporate or China networks, region blocks, Cloudflare blocks, SSL errors, cursor.com or the forum not loading.
Agent ignores instructions or rules: The agent's own choices defy what the user said: it ignores the prompt, AGENTS.md or rules, the plan or the mode, takes unrequested actions (commits, PRs, edits), or reaches outside the project. Not for features that are simply broken.
Sub-agents or task queue misbehave: Sub-agents, background tasks, multitask or the message queue: tasks never finish or pile up, the parent doesn't resume, queued messages cancel or skip, sub-agents lack tools or permissions. Wrong sub-agent model goes to 'Agent runs on the wrong model'.
Model output quality dropped: Answers or code are worse than before: hallucinations, broken code, weird output, a model that 'lost the plot' or got dumber.
Agent deleted or corrupted files: The agent or the app deleted, truncated or overwrote files, broke encodings or line endings, or lost the user's code on disk.
Can't review or undo agent changes: Keep/Undo, diffs, the review panel, checkpoints, revert or rollback don't work or show the wrong changes.
Chat history lost or can't be managed: Chats vanish, history is gone after an update or migration, a conversation can't be found, moved, restored, renamed or deleted.
Agent runs on the wrong model: Auto, sub-agents, automations or cloud agents use a different model, effort level, Fast or Max mode than the one chosen; the model switches by itself; sub-agents can't use the chosen model.
Model missing or unavailable: A model isn't in the picker, can't be selected, disappeared, or isn't offered on a plan or surface; 'Fallback Model Disabled'.
Own API key or custom model fails: Bring-your-own API keys, Override OpenAI Base URL, Azure, Bedrock, OpenRouter, local LLMs or custom model names fail or are rejected.
Terminal or sandbox commands fail: Commands the agent runs fail, hang or return no exit status; the sandbox blocks or breaks them; wrong shell (e.g. PowerShell 5.1) or environment variables; integrated terminal bugs.
Command approvals or allowlist misbehave: The command allowlist, Auto-run / Run Everything, permission prompts or approval cards don't work, keep asking, or never appear or resolve.
Hooks don't fire or send wrong data: Cursor agent hooks (hooks.json, preToolUse, sessionStart, stop, etc.) don't run or send wrong or missing data. Git hooks go to 'Git commits, hooks or branches misbehave'.
Rules, skills or plugins don't load: Cursor rules, skills (including 'Use as mode'), plugins or the plugin marketplace: not loaded or applied, can't be installed, edited or removed, marketplace submission or listing stuck. VS Code extensions go to 'VS Code extension doesn't work'. If they load but the agent disobeys them, use 'Agent ignores instructions or rules'.
MCP server won't connect or load tools: MCP servers (IDE, CLI, cloud agents, automations or Grok Bot custom MCP) fail to start, connect or authenticate (OAuth), show 0 tools, or aren't detected.
VS Code extension doesn't work: A VS Code extension (Codex, Claude Code, Python, Flutter, LaTeX, Kotlin, etc.), its webviews, commands or language servers don't work in Cursor, behave differently than in VS Code, or are missing from Cursor's extension marketplace.
Grok Bot stops responding or can't conne: The Grok Bot app shows Reconnecting, Retrying or 'Can't reach your computer', bots don't reply or 'failed to respond', messages fail to send, Grok Bot seems down. If the user says Reset, Recover or Update of the bot's computer also failed, use 'Grok Bot's computer won't reset or recover'.
Grok Bot's computer won't reset or recov: Reset, Recover, Rebuild or Update of the bot's cloud computer fails, hangs (e.g. stuck at 43%) or leaves it in a 'partial state'.
Grok Bot's computer loses data or breaks: Problems inside the bot's cloud computer (the box) while it is reachable: files, secrets, packages or logins wiped or rolled back, disk full, freezes or reboots, its browser or network can't reach sites or keep sign-ins, out of memory. Only Grok Bot's computer: cloud agent VMs go to 'Cloud agent fails or won't start'.
Grok Bot can't use my own computer: Grok Bot's local execution, My Machines or computer use on the user's own machine is offline, blocked, set to Never, or flapping between machines.
Grok Bot app connector fails: Grok Bot's built-in connectors and actions fail: Gmail, Google, 1Password, Slack, X, email inbox, webhooks, Fastmail and similar.
Grok Bot app won't set up or open: Installing, first-time setup or creating a bot fails; the Grok Bot desktop app shows a blank or black screen, crashes or won't open.
Automation, routine or Bugbot doesn't ru: Cloud Automations, Grok Bot routines, Bugbot or security reviews don't trigger, run late or wrong, or can't be created or saved.
Cloud agent fails or won't start: Cloud (background) agents and Projects worker agents fail mid-task, get stuck, or can't start; environment builds, secrets, branches or setup fail.
Projects, canvas or Origin fail: Cursor's Projects (coordinator chats, shared context, notes), canvases or Origin repos don't load, can't be created, shared or merged, or behave wrongly. Projects worker agents that fail mid-task go to 'Cloud agent fails or won't start'.
Usage drains faster than expected: Tokens, credits or included usage get used up faster than expected; huge token counts; limits hit too early.
Usage numbers or limits shown wrong: Usage meters and dashboards show wrong or stale numbers, wrong pool or reset date; spending or on-demand limits not enforced or blocking wrongly; the usage page won't load.
Unclear plan, pricing or usage rules: Any question about what plans include, prices, quotas, how usage and pools are counted (including Grok Bot vs Cursor usage), how to track or cap usage, referrals, discounts, promos, credits, education or startup programs.
Billing or team admin action fails: Can't upgrade, downgrade, subscribe, cancel or pay; invoices, refunds, payment methods, checkout sends to the wrong flow; team or enterprise admin actions (invites, seats, removing members, roles, team spend caps, admin API, team analytics) don't work.
Can't sign in: Login, 'authentication error', keychain, SSO, sign-in loops, account linking or merging, several accounts, verification codes, password reset, for Cursor or Grok Bot.
Git or GitHub integration breaks: Git inside Cursor (commits, git hooks skipped, branches, worktrees, git status, generated commit messages) or the repo host integration (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps, Vercel): connecting, repos or branches not listed, permissions, PRs that can't be created, linked or merged, wrong account or org.
Cursor is slow, crashes or hogs resource: The app as a whole is laggy, freezes, crashes, won't start or starts slowly, spawns extra processes or windows, reloads by itself, or uses huge CPU, memory or disk space (state.vscdb, caches).
App won't install or update: Installers and updates for Cursor, the CLI or the Grok Bot app fail or hang, downloads don't work, antivirus blocks the install.
Remote SSH, WSL or dev container fails: Remote-SSH, WSL, dev containers or remote servers won't connect, crash or misbehave.
Typing, paste or voice broken: Typing in the chat input or editor: keyboard shortcuts (including Cmd/Ctrl+L, Cmd/Ctrl+K), IME input (Chinese, Japanese, Korean, etc.), paste duplicating or failing, copy, text selection, attaching files, selections or context to a message; voice dictation and voice mode.
Chat or Markdown renders wrongly: Content renders wrongly: chat messages, the Markdown preview, tables, Mermaid, LaTeX or code blocks, Markdown sent to Slack; the chat pane is black or blank; messages don't show; file or web links in chat open the wrong thing or nothing. Panels closing or moving go to 'Buttons, panels or layout broken'.
Panels, tabs or windows misbehave: Panels, sidebars, tabs, split views, the Agents Window or app windows open, close, move, resize, reset or steal focus wrongly; can't close or switch them.
Interface elements missing or misdrawn: Buttons, icons, menus, text, scrollbars or dialogs are invisible, clipped, overlapping, flickering, unreadable in a theme, missing, or do nothing when clicked; popups or ads that can't be dismissed. If a control works but the feature behind it fails, use that feature's issue.
Agent status or notifications wrong: Agents shown as Working, waiting or needing input when they aren't (or the reverse), unread dots or badges that stick, notifications or sounds that fire wrongly, too often or never.
Built-in browser misbehaves: Cursor's built-in browser, Design Mode or DevTools fail; links open in the wrong place.
Mobile app or remote control broken: The iOS or Android apps (Cursor or Grok Bot), Remote Control, Live Activities or the mobile web don't work.
Agent CLI or SDK misbehaves: Bugs in cursor-agent CLI, ACP, @cursor/sdk, the Python SDK or the Cloud Agents API that no more specific label covers.
Privacy or security concern: Data leakage, secrets exposure, the agent reading .env or other private files, telemetry, privacy mode, terms of service, compliance (HIPAA, DPA), suspected malware.
